coverage_delta: +22 new tests: getMarkerColorToken (5), getOrderStatusTone + getDriverStatusTone (11), DriverPicker subtitle/busy/axe (3), DriverRow axe (1), OrderCard map-highlight hot-state (2, RED-confirmed by reverting the wiring). +existing assertions retargeted to WI-mandated markup (OrderCard failed-SMS 4, phone/dropoff 2, DriverRow+disconnect trigger label).

deviations: Marker Offline colour uses var(--ink-3) per the WI's explicit token-table instruction (spec §2 nominally lists --success/--info/--warning/--danger for status colours; Offline/gray has no danger meaning so --ink-3 is the correct neutral ink token). The order pickup pin (#ef4444) was also converted to var(--danger) to keep the touched file hex-free — matches spec §2 'order pin = danger drop pin'.

WI-mandated accessible-name changes (spec §3): failed-SMS glyph is now a DANGER DeskPill with visible text 'SMS selhala' (board.order.smsFailed) instead of the aria-labeled '✉︎⚠' glyph (notifications.failedSmsIcon); tests switched from getByLabelText(/SMS se nepodařilo…/) to getByText(/SMS selhala/). DriverRow override trigger is now a '⋯' icon button labeled 'Možnosti řidiče' (drivers.menuLabel) instead of 'Nastavit stav'; the popover keeps the 'status-override-menu' name and set-status-Free/Busy/Offline items unchanged. Per advisor, the new visible-text pills carry no redundant aria-label (axe aria-prohibited-attr safe).

Status pills switched from theme.ts colour keys to DeskPill tones via new additive pure mappers getOrderStatusTone/getDriverStatusTone in statusPill.ts; getDriverStatusInfo signature is UNTOUCHED (still returns theme colorKey/textColorKey) per the 'do not change existing pure-module signatures' rule.

OrderCard line-2 now splits the phone into a bold span, and the route block uses an accent-dot (pickup) / ink-square (dropoff) instead of the literal '→' prefix; the two OrderCard tests that encoded the old markup were updated to the new structure (still assert the same visible data).

DriverRow row is no longer role=button (it contained a nested interactive '⋯' menu button → axe nested-interactive). It stays keyboard-focusable (tabIndex 0; Enter/Space focuses the driver on the map) as a plain focusable container; the status pill keeps its driver-status-<status> aria-label wrapper so existing DriverRow tests are preserved.

DriverPicker <ul> carries role=presentation so the labelled role=listbox container's role=option children satisfy aria-required-children/parent (surfaced by the new axe test). e2e listbox name 'Vyberte řidiče' + option driver names + 'Načítám řidiče...' loading all preserved.

DriversColumn gained a header ('Řidiči' + drivers.onlineSummary) and footer (drivers.mapHint) that did not exist before — online = drivers with status != Offline. OrdersColumn section headers restyled to chevron + count pill; Dokončené dnes stays collapsed by default; section <section aria-label> region names board.sections.* preserved for the e2e contract.

HOT-HIGHLIGHT completeness (advisor catch): the WI names TWO $highlighted triggers — useNewOrderHighlight AND useMapHighlight (card whose pin is hovered). OrderCard now reads useMapHighlightStore(s => s.highlightedOrderId) via an ATOMIC selector (zustand object-selector loop trap) and sets isHighlighted = isNewHighlight || mapHighlightedId === order.id. The one-shot flash keyframe still plays for the newest order; the accent border + 2px accent halo also PERSIST while the card is the map-highlighted one (a 'selected card' look) — intended per §3. Pinned by 2 RED-first tests (halo present when this order is highlighted / absent when a different order is).

ICON SET (advisor catch): the shared stroke-SVG Icon set (src/shared/ui/icons/Icon.tsx) has 'car', 'menu', 'chevron' and its header comment bans emoji app-wide. Replaced the interim literal glyphs with <Icon>: driver-line 🚗 -> <Icon name="car">, DriverRow ⋯ overflow -> <Icon name="menu"> (the set has no ellipsis glyph; 'menu' is the closest overflow affordance), OrdersColumn ▸/▾ -> <Icon name="chevron"> rotated 90deg when expanded. All decorative (no title => aria-hidden), monochrome currentColor so they read correctly in the desk kit and dark mode. No literal emoji remain in any rendered board UI.
